purpose: The single source of truth for behavioural clause failures the owner has accepted as open in docs/runtime-wall-trace.json. Read by scripts/build.mjs (the release gate) and by tests/runtime-evidence-binding.test.mjs (the tripwire), so the build and the tripwire cannot disagree about what is recorded.
owner_decision: 2026-09-21 — release gate semantics. The default build passes when there is no UNRECORDED gate failure and gate.timing_and_dli_passed is true. A new failure, or a recorded failure that silently disappears, fails the build exactly as it fails the tripwire. gate.passed keeps its meaning: false while any failure is recorded.

classes.a-stale-scenario: (a) The scenario cannot contain the behaviour; the assertion is right. Fixed by extending the scenario, never by loosening the assertion — recorded when extending is not cheap.
classes.b-wrong-selection: (b) The clause reads the wrong coverage; fixed by correcting the selection and proving the corrected clause still fails when the behaviour is missing.
classes.c-real-failure: (c) A real failure of the build. Neither fixed nor weakened here; recorded so the evidence stays a truthful description of the build.
classes.pre-existing-unclassified: Pre-existing failure carried unchanged; no session has classified it into (a), (b) or (c) yet.

failures.message: lower-playfield-hostile-contact-atr-hard did not capture 16 consecutive contact rasters
failures.note: MEASURED 2026-10-01: on HARD the hostile shells of level 1 stop at Y 180, under the policy's shell_y >= 191; on MEDIUM (probe) they follow the player and stop at Y 156, so a difficulty change does not repair it. RENAMED 2026-09-30 with its session (owner decision 1, docs/plans/atr-only-build.md §5): the XEX-only session switched to the ATR as -atr-hard. Owner decision 2026-10-01 (trace-clause-repairs, Q3): stays recorded, reclassified from pre-existing-unclassified to (a); the redesign of the contact scenarios is chore/contact-scenario-redesign. RE-DIAGNOSED 2026-10-02 (contact-scenario-redesign, owner decision Q1: kept as it is, class (a)): (1) its steering `target_y = shell_y - 7` predates the final-raster collision of 4753399, so even a qualifying shell cannot give the mode-1 raster contact; (2) on HARD level 1 a low hostile shell (BROAD_Y >= 191) is rare and late: with the contact preamble and a passive player the hostile launches after the sector opens are fixed (116, 180, 180, 116, 172, 172, 180, 180 through +908) whatever the preamble row, and low ones appeared only after ~+840 frames (220 at 1504, 212 at 1582, 220 at +917), each time behind a debris hit or a low Allied damage call. The lower-row contact raster is gated since then by the Allied session lower-playfield-allied-contact-atr-hard. Follow-up: the hostile lower-row contact gets an honest scenario in M5, where the boss's lasers make low hostile shells frequent; the M5 plan must cover it.

entries.message: Booster release did not clear the capsule from its PMG plane in the release frame
entries.fix: The observer counted entries to clear_fighter_pickup_pmg; the publication's re-entry on an empty plane erases nothing. It now counts the entries that zero the plane (additive header field pickup_erase_writes): 1 on each of the four release frames, plane empty.

entries.message: capital-contact-allied-medium did not capture 16 consecutive contact rasters
entries.fix: Scenario (a): contact preamble on row 225 (sweep + FIRE under a trace-only respawn-invulnerability hold until the capital sector first opens, 667), budget 560 -> 840. Observers (b): player oracle reads P0 alone (P3 is the capsule's since 800322b); 16-frame raster window for the contact kinds (4753399 widened it to 32 for the geometry kind); hitbox clause in final-raster scanlines (production since 4753399). Contact 795, Allied slot 0, mode 1, shell 113-118 x player 109-123, hull 10 -> 8; all contact clauses pass.
